name: Terry Davis Hands on Hips
aliases: all my work is placed in the public domain
description: Terry Davis on the TempleOS homepage, standing hands on hips in his bare room wearing a backwards cap, shorts and a TempleOS t-shirt, above the line "All my work is placed in the public domain. I am schizophrenic."
usage: Standing proudly behind your work, however strange it is. Good for self-hosted, open source, made-it-all-myself energy.
